recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future generated artifact or terminology refactor reintroduces the obsolete totalcount spelling.
issue_request: FHIR-16495 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 OO change request asking to rename the Observation statistics code totalcount to total-count for consistency with other multi-word codes.
initial_application: Git commit 69761b715e5c64e5f02da9d3cab64b40f1b00d1b applied the request by changing the old source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml statistics row from totalcount to total-count. Later source rework created the current explicit Observation statistics CodeSystem and OperationDefinition with total-count preserved.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Observation statistics CodeSystem defines total-count, the ValueSet includes that CodeSystem, and the Observation-stats OperationDefinition lists total-count in its possible statistical analyses. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-16495-specific discussion; a 2016 Zulip Observation Statistics thread discussed the total-count concept but did not conflict with the later hyphenated code spelling. Related Observation issues from the same and nearby history are already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current build-scope source already satisfies the issue and no stale totalcount spelling remains under source/.
